site_model: Fictional factory roof: 3500 m2 gross, 500 m2 setbacks, 3000 m2 usable; 30-year modeled remaining roof service life. No structural load verification or landlord consent.
engineering_model: 300 x 550 Wp modules, 3 x 50 kWac inverters; 20 strings of 15; modeled 25-year horizon. Inverter renewal at year 13 with linked cash CAPEX and one-year downtime scenario.
commercial_model: Owner self-use plus surplus export. Synthetic representative 2025 hourly resource and factory-load profile; 0.76 CNY/kWh modeled avoidable daytime energy charge and 0.42 CNY/kWh export, no demand-charge savings. Not an executed tariff.
capital_model: Initial modules 300 x 700 CNY, inverters 3 x 24000 CNY, mounting 90000 CNY, construction 95000 CNY; year-13 replacement inverters 3 x 24000 CNY. All declared paid in scenario, not historical cash proof.
operating_model: Maintenance 7200 CNY and insurance 3800 CNY per first year, 2% annual escalation through year 25. Unlevered financing, CNY nominal post-tax end-year discount 7.5%; forecast collections and OPEX payments 100% each period.
constraints: No real roof engineering signoff, fire approval, grid permission, metered load, supplier quote, tax opinion, or legally enforceable land/roof title. All documentary references are authored synthetic modeling notes only.
